access_token = resp['access_token']

current_year = datetime.now().year
all_entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True)

internet_txt = [p for p in all_entries if p.startswith('/home/chelsea/bills/internet/') and p.endswith('.txt')]
pattern = re.compile(rf'^/home/chelsea/bills/internet/{current_year}-\\d\\d\\.txt$')
internet_this_year = sorted([p for p in internet_txt if pattern.match(p)])

print('internet_this_year', internet_this_year)

amounts = []
for path in internet_this_year:
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=path)
    content = f['content']
    # find Total Amount => $X or Total Amount => X
    m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*[:=]\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    amt = float(m.group(1)) if m else None
    amounts.append((path, amt))

print('parsed_amounts', amounts)

total = sum(a for _, a in amounts if a is not None)
print('total', total)

import re
from datetime import datetime

# --- compute total internet bills for current year ---
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pw = next(item['password'] for item in pw_list if item['account_name']=='file_system')

login_resp = apis.file_system.login(username='chelsea-burch@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

current_year = datetime.now().year
all_entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True)

internet_txt = [p for p in all_entries if p.startswith('/home/chelsea/bills/internet/') and p.endswith('.txt')]
pattern = re.compile(rf'^/home/chelsea/bills/internet/{current_year}-\d\d\.txt$')
internet_this_year = sorted([p for p in internet_txt if pattern.match(p)])

amounts = []
for path in internet_this_year:
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=path)
    content = f['content']
    m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*[:=]\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    amt = float(m.group(1)) if m else None
    amounts.append((path, amt))

parsed_total = sum(a for _, a in amounts if a is not None)
total_rounded = round(parsed_total + 1e-9, 2)

print('explored_apps_apis')
print({
    'file_system': ['api_docs.show_api_descriptions', 'login', 'show_directory', 'show_file'],
    'supervisor': ['show_account_passwords', 'complete_task'],
    'api_docs': ['show_api_descriptions', 'show_api_doc']
})
print('current_year', current_year)
print('internet_files', internet_this_year)
print('parsed_amounts', amounts)
print('total_rounded', total_rounded)

# --- complete task ---
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=total_rounded)
